装饰装修产值包括装饰、装修两部分产值。装修装饰指对新旧房屋及建筑物进行的内外装修: Output value of decoration and fitting-out comprises the output value of decoration and of fitting-out. Decoration and fitting-out refers to interior and exterior decoration and fitting-out of new and existing houses and buildings; secondary decoration and fitting-out of newly built houses and buildings that, after construction, do not yet fully meet usable standards; and secondary interior and exterior decoration of existing houses after some years of use. It includes plastering, doors and windows, glazing, suspended ceilings, partitions, facing panels (tiles), coatings, wallpapering, whitewashing and ornamental work.
